Fix CI: resolve container health check failures

Root cause: dbal:run-sql returns exit code 255 on "Connection refused",
which the entrypoint treated as unrecoverable, aborting the retry loop
after 1 attempt. The container then exit 1'd, restarted, failed again,
and Docker marked it unhealthy.

- Remove exit code 255 short-circuit from database wait loop
- Add depends_on with service_healthy condition for database
- Add generous health check overrides (120s start_period, 10 retries)
- Include tests/, .env.test, *.dist in Docker build context for CI
- Use APP_ENV=dev in CI stage (test env causes _test db suffix issues)
- Add MySQL init script to create app_test database for Codeception

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Mercure needs demo mode in CI (no JWT keys available), same as the dev

debugging.
